title: DiRAFT: Privacy-Aware Financial Transcript Synthesis from Aggregate Discourse Priors
abstract: arXiv:2610.40938v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Using customer conversations to train and evaluate financial language models raises confidentiality concerns because non-public financial facts can remain after direct identifiers are masked. Synthetic transcripts offer an alternative data source, but their discourse fidelity and residual confidentiality risks require assessment. We introduce DiRAFT (Discourse Realization from Aggregate First-order Transitions), which extracts financial concept graphs and records the order in which concepts are first introduced. It pools adjacent concept transitions across training records and samples new graph plans from aggregate transition, starting-concept, and plan-length priors. A discourse layer guides text realization without supplying an individual source passage or graph. translated_title: DiRAFT：基于聚合话语先验的隐私感知金融对话记录合成
translated_abstract: 使用客户对话来训练和评估金融语言模型会引发保密性问题，因为即使在直接标识符被遮蔽后，非公开的金融事实仍可能残留在数据中。合成对话记录提供了一种替代数据源，但其话语保真度和残留保密风险需要评估。我们提出了DiRAFT（基于聚合一阶转移的话语实现），该方法提取金融概念图并记录概念首次被引入的顺序。它在训练记录之间汇集相邻概念间的转移模式，并从聚合转移、起始概念和计划长度等先验分布中采样新的图规划。一个话语层引导文本实现，而不提供任何单独的源文本段落或图。我们通过两项互补评估来考察隐私相关风险：语料库层面的结构重叠度分析，以及针对特定非公开投资者事实的基于源文本的核查。
tldr: 论文提出DiRAFT方法，通过汇聚训练语料中聚合的一阶概念转移、起始概念与计划长度先验来采样全新话语结构图并引导文本生成，在不使用任何单一样本的情况下合成金融对话记录，兼顾话语保真度与隐私保护。
en_tdlr: DiRAFT synthesizes privacy-aware financial transcripts by sampling novel discourse structure graphs from aggregate first-order transition, starting-concept, and plan-length priors pooled across training records, without relying on any individual source passage, thereby balancing discourse fidelity with reduced confidentiality risks.
